shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files; head -c 600 package-lock.json
for f in index.html src/* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15; npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | head; grep -E '"(version|peerDependencies)"' -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build 2>/dev/null | head; ls styles 2>/dev/null; grep -n '"exports"' -A25 package.json | head -50; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 'styles' README.md | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,80p TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls Checkbox PasswordInput 2>&1 | head -20

cat components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -80; echo ======; sed -n 1,80p components/controls/TextInput.md; echo ======; sed -n 1,50p components/Checkbox.md; echo =====; sed -n 1,40p guides/theming.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; sed -n 1,60p Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,40p ../../docs/components/Card.md; grep -n "Flex" -m5 ../../docs/guides/layout.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides && sed -n 30,110p layout.md; grep -n "Card\b" ../components/Card.md | sed -n 1,3p; sed -n 40,100p ../components/Card.md

sed -i 's/^  place-items: center;/  place-items: center;\n  padding: var(--g-spacing-4);\n  box-sizing: border-box;/' src/index.css && cat src/index.css && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
rm -rf dist && which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>&1 | head -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>&1 | head -3; git diff package.json
